title: Download my data
summary: Gives the user a copy of what the Bipe API stores about them as one JSON file (LGPD art. 18, ADR 0112). The owner proves it is them first; the file goes to the system share sheet. Messages are not on the server, so the file does not have them.

phase.description: confirmIdentity: biometrics or the phone's passcode. enterPin: no owner check on the phone, so the app lock PIN. preparing: GET /v1/me/export runs. failed: see error.

pinWrong.description: enterPin: the last app lock PIN did not match.

start.effect: From the export row in Privacidade. Biometrics or the phone's passcode when the phone has them (bipe_privacy_export_biometric); else the app lock PIN when the lock is on; else failed with bipe_privacy_export_error (fail closed).

pin.description: The app lock PIN. Never logged.

submitPin.effect: Checks it on the device. A match calls export; a miss sets pinWrong (error haptic, use pin_wrong).

export.effect: GET /v1/me/export. 200: saves the body as it is, with the file name from content-disposition (bipe-dados-YYYY-MM-DD.json), in a cache folder that holds only the latest export, and opens the system share sheet with it. 429: failed with bipe_error_rate_limited. Anything else: failed with bipe_privacy_export_error.

dismiss.effect: Closes the dialog. Nothing is kept but the latest file in the cache folder.

notes: The app does not parse the file. It saves the bytes and shares them (api/openapi.yaml /v1/me/export). 3 exports per hour per account.
A file name that is not a plain bipe-dados-*.json name becomes bipe-dados-<today>.json (no path, no leading dot).

The export covers server data only: account state, recovery email, handle and its history, public profile, messaging and discovery settings, phone link status, invites, the CNPJ claim, terms acceptances and growth events. bipe_privacy_export_footer says that chats are not in it.

Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.exportMyData and BipeDataExport.filename (BipeKit BipeSettingsSupport.swift); BipeApiClient.export, BipeDataExportFile and BipeDataExportRow (libraries/bipe api and settings).
product/data.json is the LGPD record of what the server keeps; the whatBipeKeeps row opens its public page (/lgpd/).
